_about: The 20 materials of the web calculator AND of the strength model (one list for both). name = what the web shows and the column in excel/04 Dataset_web.xlsx; key = model input; datamix = column in 01 Datamix.xlsx that gives density, cost, energy and CO2; group: binder = Cement/FA/GGBS (their shares add up to 1), ratio = mass ratio to that binder, fiber = vol% of the mix. Fibers (PE, PVA, steel; PBO was removed): length_mm, diameter_um, tensile_strength_mpa, elastic_modulus_gpa = the values the web suggests AND the values the model uses when a paper does not report them. PE 18 mm / 12 um / 2700 MPa / 88 GPa: Table 3 of 10.1016/j.ceramint.2022.12.057 (same fiber in most papers of Prof. Bang Yeon Lee's lab, Chonnam National University). PVA 8 mm / 40 um / 1600 MPa / 41 GPa: Table 4 of 10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2015.07.182 (same lab). Steel 13 mm / 200 um / 2200 MPa: 10.3390/ma15051668 (no steel fiber in the lab papers); its modulus is not stated there, 200 GPa = the most common steel modulus in excel/04 Dataset_web.xlsx (178 of 278 rows that report it).
